translation: For all vacuous vexation one should only use the Zhuye Decoction (Bamboo Leaf Decoction). (The Zhuye Decoction is in the third volume, in the section on epidemic vacuous vexation, from the Wenzhong formula.) If one vomits, give the Jupi Decoction (Tangerine Peel Decoction); if one dose does not cure, one may give it again. (The Jupi Decoction is the one of four ingredients in the second volume, in the section on cold damage with vomiting and retching, from the Shenshi formula.) This method Guan Tai used many times with great effect; vacuous vexation after cold damage should also take this decoction.
